class.name: Box3DCharacterMover
class.description: [Box3DCharacterMover] exposes Box3D's geometric capsule mover to scripts. It is a query-only mover, not a simulated body. Call [method setup] with a Box3D space [RID], configure the capsule and collision mask, then drive it from fixed-tick movement code. The mover origin is at the character's feet. [method set_capsule] takes Godot-style total capsule height and radius, but [method move], [method cast_motion], and [method collide] expect [param position] to be the feet position, not the capsule center. [method move] runs the Box3D mover loop using 5 iterations and a 1 cm delta tolerance. The returned [code]cast_fraction[/code] is the last iteration's cast fraction and is intended for diagnostics. When [member step_height] is greater than zero, [method move] also performs capsule-safe stair stepping. A grounded lateral move that encounters an obstruction and loses horizontal progress is compared with an up/forward/down sweep in the same call. This catches the partial upward roll of a round capsule at a stair lip instead of waiting for the mover to stop. The landing is classified by downward ray probes (under the capsule axis, then just past the support contact) instead of the capsule contact normal — a capsule resting on a step lip reports a tilted hemisphere normal that would otherwise fail the [member floor_max_angle] test. The same probes keep [code]on_floor[/code] true while the capsule rides a step lip across ticks. Stepping is skipped for airborne movement and while moving upward (jumps). Surfaces steeper than [member floor_max_angle] and thin lips (fence rails) are still rejected. Plane dictionaries returned by [method collide] contain [code]normal[/code], [code]offset[/code], and [code]local_point[/code] in the frame of the position passed to [method collide]. [code]point[/code] is world-space. Feed planes back to [method solve_planes] and [method clip_velocity] unchanged for the same position.

method.name: get_collision_mask
method.description: Returns the physics layer mask used by mover queries.

method.name: get_floor_max_angle
method.description: Returns the floor angle limit in radians.

method.name: cast_motion
method.description: Casts the mover from feet [param position] along [param translation] and returns the safe travel fraction in the range [code][0, 1][/code]. Returns [code]0.0[/code] if the mover cannot query the space.

method.name: clip_velocity
method.description: Clips [param velocity] against mover collision [param planes].

method.name: collide
method.description: Returns collision plane dictionaries for the mover at feet [param position].

method.name: move
method.description: Moves from feet [param position] by [param velocity] over [param delta]. Returns a dictionary with [code]position[/code], [code]velocity[/code], [code]on_floor[/code], [code]on_wall[/code], [code]on_ceiling[/code], [code]floor_normal[/code], [code]floor_material_id[/code], [code]floor_material_name[/code], [code]floor_material[/code], [code]planes[/code], [code]cast_fraction[/code], [code]iterations[/code], and [code]stepped[/code] ([code]true[/code] when a [member step_height] stair step was performed this call). Floor material fields are probe-derived.

method.name: set_capsule
method.description: Sets the feet-origin capsule using total [param height] and [param radius]. Heights below [code]radius * 2[/code] are clamped.

method.name: set_collision_mask
method.description: Sets the physics layer mask used by mover queries.

method.name: set_exclusions
method.description: Sets body RIDs excluded from mover casts and collision-plane gathering.

method.name: set_floor_max_angle
method.description: Sets the floor angle limit in radians.

method.name: setup
method.description: Binds this mover to a Box3D physics space.

method.name: solve_planes
method.description: Solves [param target_delta] against mover collision [param planes]. Returns [code]delta[/code], [code]iterations[/code], and updated [code]planes[/code].

members.member: Maximum floor angle in radians. Defaults to 45 degrees.
Maximum stair riser height [method move] can climb, in meters. [code]0.0[/code] disables stepping and probe-based grounding entirely, preserving the plain mover loop.
